protocol: One model and fixed FFN plans, separate old/new first-stage graphs and histories. Forty AB/BA pairs per budget and input sequence. CPU image/state through denormalized CPU actions. No stage instrumentation during timing.
fixture: Original request and synthetic +64 modulo-256 RGB changes in 40/70/110 spatial tiles; not closed-loop.
comparison: Token reuse enabled before and after the transport/selection optimization; this is not an ON/OFF ablation.

validation.equality: Exact array/tensor equality; no tolerance used for before/after comparisons.

changes: Keep the original float32 RGB difference and threshold reduction; eliminate extra image/absolute-value allocations.
Pack per-layer FFN caches into one tensor to reduce copy calls.
Borrow first-stage graph outputs inside a serialized request, bump versions after replay, and clone only the committed feature/FFN history.

limitations: Offline latency, not closed-loop task success.
Changing-input timing alternates one synthetic changed tile, staying in the 32-token capacity. All four capacities are covered by separate exact state comparisons.
Audit releases graphs between capacity checks to fit both implementations beside existing GPU processes; measured pairs never capture graphs.
These incremental changes preserve the prior approximate token-reuse results, not equality with native eager or token reuse disabled.
